# Duck Initiative

> Duck Initiative is a small studio making add-ons for Blender. Its add-ons are sold under the label Waddle by Duck Initiative. The first one is Polygraph, which shows the vertex count a game engine will really load, checks it against a platform budget, and lists what to cut first.

Key facts:

- Polygraph 1.0 comes out on December 8, 2026. It runs on Blender 4.2 and later, on Windows, macOS and Linux.
- Blender counts the vertices it stores. glTF, Unity and Unreal Engine count them after splitting every UV seam and sharp edge. The default cube is 8 vertices in Blender and 24 in any engine. Polygraph counts the way each engine imports.
- Editions: Free; Pro for one person, $19; Studio for a team of five, $249. Pro and Studio go to $25 and $329 on January 12, 2027, when 2.0 comes out. 2.0 is free for everyone who owns 1.x.
- Free is on extensions.blender.org and Gumroad. Pro and Studio are on Superhive and Gumroad.
- 32 budgets ship with Pro and Studio and 5 with Free (Meta Quest, VRChat, Roblox, Fortnite UEFN, visionOS and more). 26 of them cite the page their limits come from. There are 21 mesh checks in every edition.
- Every edition is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later and can be used for paid work. There is no account and no licence key, and Polygraph works offline.
- Polygraph does not decimate or retopologise meshes, and it does not run inside Unity or Unreal.
- More add-ons are being made: Dancefloor, Abandonify and Proxyforge. None has a release date yet.

## Polygraph

- [Polygraph guide](https://duckinitiative.com/polygraph/): installing it, every panel, engine counts, the 32 budgets and their sources, the 21 mesh checks, Where to Cut, What If, reports, the command line check and the Python API.
- [Editions compared](https://duckinitiative.com/polygraph/#editions): what Free, Pro and Studio each include, feature by feature.
- [Licence and terms](https://duckinitiative.com/polygraph/license/): the GPL code, what a purchase covers, how seats are counted, updates and the 2.0 upgrade.
- [Refunds](https://duckinitiative.com/polygraph/refunds/): 30 days from purchase; what is covered and how to ask.
- [Press kit](https://duckinitiative.com/polygraph/press/): the short description, a fact table, screenshots, clips and logos, free to use in coverage.

## Duck Initiative and Waddle

- [Home](https://duckinitiative.com/): the studio, Polygraph in short, and the email sign-up for release news.
- [Blender add-ons](https://duckinitiative.com/addons.html): Polygraph's editions and prices, and the add-ons that are coming.
- [Waddle](https://duckinitiative.com/waddle.html): the shop label. Add-ons are listed as "Waddle by Duck Initiative" on Blender Extensions, Superhive and Gumroad.
